summary: Backend-only regression testing for the new Admin panel + kick feature. Created /app/backend/tests/test_admin_kick.py with 12 tests covering all 9 review items across 5 games (TheBestTiket, Survival, ScoreAndLive, FantaGiornata, Bonus) + admin management (promote / list / delete-with-cascade). All 12 tests PASS (100%) under pytest-xdist parallel scheduling. Verified: (1) POST /api/auth/admin/promote creates a new admin whose login returns must_change_password=true; (2) GET /api/auth/users returns list without password_hash for admins and 403 for players; (3) DELETE /api/auth/users/{id} enforces 'cannot delete self' guard (which shields the last-admin path); (4) DELETE cascades — a joined player is fully removed from memberships after deletion; (5–8) kick endpoints on rooms, sv-tournaments, sal-tournaments, fg-leagues each: 400 on admin target, 200 on player + kicked_user_id in body, 404 on repeat kick; (9) bonus /configs/{cid}/kick/{user_id} requires an actual pick — created a SAL tournament, submitted a scorer pick, verified picks-admin lists it, kicked player, verified deleted_picks>=1 + picks-admin no longer shows the user + repeat kick returns 404; (10) GET /api/bonus/configs/{cid}/picks-admin returns 401 without auth, 403 with player token, 200 + correct shape ({config_id, picks:[]}) with admin token. All test data (rooms, tournaments, leagues, configs, players, calendars for the throw-away season) is cleaned up in try/finally blocks — DB left clean after run.

minor.issue: The 'last admin' safeguard is currently unreachable via /admin/login (self-delete 400 fires first). If a second admin ever exists and is deleted before the seed admin, only the self-delete guard prevents deleting the last one. Consider swapping the order of the two 400 checks (target-role check first) so an admin trying to delete _themselves_ when they are the last admin still gets the more accurate error. Non-blocking — the current code is still safe.

The endpoint returns 404 'Il giocatore non ha fatto pronostici per questo bonus' when the user has no picks. This means kick is not idempotent — repeat kick fails. Behaviour matches the review request (which requires 404 on repeat), so this is documented, not a bug.

critical_code_review_comments: auth.py:326-338 — 'last admin' safeguard sits AFTER the self-delete 400 check, so an admin cannot ever hit the 'unico admin rimasto' branch by deleting themselves. Works as intended today (self-delete blocks first), but if you ever remove the self-delete guard, reorder the checks.

bonus.py:414-449 — kick endpoint deletes by (season, matchday, bonus_type, user_id) across all games. This is correct given the review request but note that if a user has picks for multiple games (score AND fanta) on the same bonus_type/matchday, ALL of them are deleted in a single kick. This matches the 'HARD kick' requirement.

surviva.py:591-624, scoreandlive.py:921-959, fantagiornata.py:404-447, thebesttiket.py:1509-1539 — all four kick endpoints correctly (a) check target != resource-admin, (b) verify target user exists, (c) verify target is actually a participant, (d) cascade-delete picks/lineups/schedine, (e) return {ok, kicked_user_id, deleted_*}. Consistent, well-mirrored implementations.
bonus.py:931-951 picks-admin does not paginate. For a large-scale bonus (thousands of users), the response could grow unbounded. Minor — acceptable for current scale.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates its own throw-away rooms/tournaments/leagues/configs/players prefixed with TEST_ and a unique 10-char season 'k<uuid8>' shared across the sv/sal/bonus tests via a module-scoped `seeded_calendar` fixture. All resources are teardown-deleted in try/finally blocks; no orphan data was observed after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_admin_kick.py is safe to rerun (isolated season, module-scoped calendar seed, per-test cleanup). It runs green under pytest-xdist. If you extend it, note that the bonus 'first_scorer' bonus_type only accepts games 'score' and 'fanta' (see BONUS_TYPE_BY_GAME in bonus.py:47); 'exact_score' only accepts 'tiket' and 'survival' and additionally requires a big_match reference matching an existing calendar fixture.
rca_of_issue: N/A — new feature verified. Only issue encountered during test authoring: /api/sal/calendar/import caps `season` at 10 characters (pydantic validator returned 422 for 'admk-<hex6>'). Fixed the test seed to 'k<hex8>' (=9 chars). Not a bug in the feature under review — pre-existing calendar validator.
